name: Volley Bomb
desc:
Bump or Spike the ball towards other players. 
It explodes when it touches the ground.

So if it falls in your square, then Dive to save it using [E]!

Controls:
Bump: Left Mouse Button/Tap UI Button/Tap Screen/R2
Spike: JUMP + Left Mouse Button/Tap UI Button/Tap Screen/R2
Dive: E/Tap UI Button/R1
Ability: R/Tap UI Button/L2

USE SHIFT LOCK!

llm.loop: bump or spike an exploding volleyball toward other players' squares -> dive to save balls landing in yours -> last one standing wins -> earn currency for ball/explosion skins
llm.objectives: keep the bomb ball out of your square and eliminate others
llm.instructions: bump/spike with M1, dive with E, use abilities with R, use shift lock
unique: volleyball crossed with hot-potato bomb elimination
llm.thumbnails: cartoon avatars spiking and diving for a lit-fuse red volleyball on grass squares
llm.complexity_notes: small arena, ball physics and hit timing, simple round logic
